theses.thesis: Among eligible, scorable themes, Gold Miners has the strongest durability (0.80) and full breadth (1.0) with no crowding. The detector's momentum rank has no demonstrated forward edge and direction accuracy is below 0.5, so even a strong durability reading may not pay.
